feat: deploy Cloudflare Worker API to production (api.mcc-cal.com)

- Created self-contained worker.js with no external dependencies
- Updated wrangler.toml with KV namespace ID and correct main file
- Deployed Worker to Cloudflare with all endpoints live
- JWT authentication working (24-hour tokens, HS256)
- Blog posts API working (GET/POST with Bearer token auth)
- Manifest serving working (concert, events, journalism, etc)
- Rate limiting configured (100 req/min per IP)
- CORS configured for *.mcc-cal.com subdomains
- Cache control headers set (10min manifests, 5min posts)
- All endpoints tested and verified working live
- Fixed manifest path handling for case-insensitive lookups
